Vallenuova

A slow afternoon in a little Italian hill town.

Terracotta roofs, cypress trees, a piazza fountain and a little café terrace. This is an imagined Italian hill town, inspired by the warm stone villages of central Italy.

Drag to rotate; scroll or pinch to zoom. Light cycles through day, sunset and night. Traffic and People cycle through moving, paused and hidden. Pause stops village life. Tap the red sports car to inspect it. Keys: 1 / 2 / 3 light, R reset, Space pause.

Clock uses local time in Rome, including daylight saving. Scene lighting is controlled separately.
